items.title: 34 blackbucks die; 20 go missing in 15 months
items.blurb: The population in the Khairapur conservation area has fallen to 210, with leopard attacks accounting for the most deaths.

items.title: Nepal’s disaster panel is debating what to call the Bhotekoshi floods. ‘Himalayan tsunami’ isn’t on the list
items.blurb: Prime Minister Balendra Shah used the term at the UN, but experts on the government panel say they are considering other names for the August 26 disaster.

items.title: India renews export approvals for four Nepali hydropower projects
items.blurb: The approvals had expired during the peak export season.

items.title: Nepal scales back flood search as Rs559b reconstruction effort begins
items.blurb: The government has suspended search and rescue operations for Bhotekoshi-Trishuli floods except in emergencies, directing authorities to accelerate reconstruction and rehabilitation in flood-hit areas.

items.title: Two workers killed as earth collapses during road work in Baglung
items.blurb: Three workers were buried while building a road in Nisikhola, days after a landslide killed five people in the same area.

items.title: Journalist Kunda Dixit on a young, fragile Himalayas—and the risks Nepal is ignoring
items.blurb: Dixit, who has written about climate and environment for decades, says Nepal must rethink how it builds and plans for disasters in a rapidly changing mountain landscape.
